en.tagline: Post a load and let carriers send you offers
en.description: An online freight marketplace for Bosnia and Herzegovina. Post what needs moving, from parcels to furniture and vehicles, and drivers bid for the job. Compare prices, ratings and profiles, then pick the best offer.

page.h1: Berza.ba — post your load, carriers bid for it
body: Post what needs moving, from parcels to furniture and vehicles, and drivers bid for the job. Instead of calling five hauliers and haggling on the phone, the offers come to you.
Compare prices, ratings and profiles, then pick whoever suits you. An online freight exchange for Bosnia and Herzegovina.
features: Post what is being moved, from where and to where
Carrier ratings and profiles in one place
